*
*
* Title: IMICKIOD
* Author: Kerry Clark
* Date Written: 07-24-94
* Oracle Vers. Orig.: 7.0
* Forms Vers. Orig.: 3.0
* Revision History:
*
* Modified By Modified Date Version Description of changes
* ---------------------------------------------------------------
* Kerry Clark 07-28-94 1.0 Initial Version
* Kerry Clark 08-02-94 2.0 Demo corrections
* Kerry Clark 08-02-94 3.0 Demo updates
* Kerry Clark 08-19-94 4.0 add building for location id
* Kerry Clark 08-24-94 5.0 remove building for location id
* update structural testing;
* Kerry Clark 08-29-94 6.0 pts:st0070 structural tests
* changed listval for product code
* others were cosmetic
* Kerry Clark 08-30-94 7.0 insert program id on updates
* and inserts
* Kerry Clark 08-31-94 8.0 replaced commit, left commented
* out from previous debug
* M. Hoang 11-19-94 17.0 removed product_history code,
* go next record after commit
*
* Abstract:
* This form is used to check outdate products into discard
* inventory for the Serve*Care system from the serve care system.
*
* Menu Reference:
*
* Error Conditions:
*
* show_error('0200'); -- no products selected
* show_error('0223'); -- at last record
* show_error('0300'); -- invalid blood type
* show_error('0307'); -- invalid collection date
* show_error('0308'); -- invalid exp_date
* show_error('0309'); -- invalid product code
* show_error('0312'); -- invalid unit id
* show_error('0313'); -- invalid aliquot
* show_error('0322'); -- invalid product type
* show_error('0700'); -- invalid scan length
* show_error('3300'); -- invalid pick slip id
* show_error('3301'); -- Product does not belong to pick
* show_error('3305'); -- invalid product status
* show_error('3702'); -- invalid insert date
* show_error('6300'); -- Product already discarded
* show_error('0241'); -- value must be numberic
* show_error('0340'); -- invalid building
*
* Inputs:
* Unit ID,Product Code, Aliquot
*
* Outputs:
* Update the following data base tables:
* 1. Active_Products
* 4. Discard_products
* 5. Pick_slips
* 6. Pick_slip_products
*
* Modules Referenced:
* Srvlib
*
* Assumptions and Limitations:
* Products checked in are expected to be out of date and checked
* in from an outdate pick slip.
*
* Functional Descriptions:
* Units are scanned or manually entered. The user must enter
* enter the unit_id and Product_code. If there is more than
* one aliquot for this product then the user must enter the
* unique aliquot. The form will determine the product type
* blood type, expiration date and it will determine the
* location ID. It will commit per record entered and
* determine if the pick slip should be close as determined
* below for Pick_slips table.
*
* Active_products
* delete the matching record
* Discard_products
* Insert new record(s)
* set product_status as 'CK' checked in
* set discard_type as 'OD' outdate
* location ID is currently a dummy location
* it will need to be a outdate location
* Pick_slips
* show pick_slip_status as 'CL' closed only if
* all the products on this pick slip in pick slip
* products have been checked in.
* Pick_slip_products
* set product_status to 'CK' checked in
*****************************************************************************

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_aliquot number;
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 -- get product type
 get_product_type;
 -- what type of discard type is this

---
--- modified for both the schemes to coexists
---
IF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'I' THEN
 :product_info.aliquot := substr(:product_info.product_code,7,2);
 go_item('product_info.aliquot');
 execute_trigger('KEY-NEXT-ITEM');
ELSIF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'C' THEN
 NEXT_ITEM;
 begin
 
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_discard_type = :g_discard_type_ot
 then
 begin
 select max(to_number(aliquot))
 into temp_aliquot
 from pick_slip_products
 where unit_id = :product_info.unit_id
 and product_code = :product_info.product_code
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and pick_slip_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_pick_slip_id
 and chapter_id = :g_chapter_id
 and exp_date < sysdate
 and product_status = :g_product_status;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('0313'); -- invalid aliquot
 check_package_failure;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 if temp_aliquot = 1
 then
 -- make sure this product has not already been discarded
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from discard_products
 where unit_id = :product_info.unit_id
 and product_code = :product_info.product_code
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and pick_slip_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_pick_slip_id
 and exp_date < sysdate
 and aliquot = :product_info.aliquot;
 :product_info.aliquot := '';
 :s_product_code := '';
 GO_ITEM('s_product_code');
 show_error_dist('6300'); -- Product already discarded
 check_package_failure;
 
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 begin
 :product_info.aliquot := temp_aliquot;
 execute_trigger('KEY-NEXT-ITEM');
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 
 -- not an out date product
 elsif :s_discard_type in (':g_discard_type_bi',
 ':g_discard_type_nf')
 then
 begin
 null; -- for future handling of nft/bio
 end;
 end if;
 end;
 END IF;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 temp_v_unit_id varchar2(17) := ltrim(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id) ||
 ltrim(lpad(to_char(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year),2,'0')) ||
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no;
 temp_v_unit_serial_no varchar2(11) := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no ; 
 temp_v_out_unit_id varchar2(15) := null;
 temp_v_out_chk_digit varchar2(2) := null; 
BEGIN
 default_value(NULL,'GLOBAL.unit_serial_no') ; 
 IF (NVL(length(temp_v_unit_serial_no), 0) in ('7','10') or :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NOT NULL) 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id IS NULL 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year IS NULL
 THEN
 -- Assume it to be a CODABAR unit.
 IF :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF temp_v_unit_serial_no = :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no THEN
 Validate_Unit_Scan_Codabar(temp_v_unit_id,'M','C',temp_v_out_unit_id);
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := temp_v_out_unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL; 
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'C';
 :GLOBAL.coll_id := null;
 :GLOBAL.coll_year := null;
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := null;
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left); 
 ELSE
 IF NVL(length(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no), 0) != 
 NVL(length(:GLOBAL.unit_serial_no), 0) THEN
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no := ''; 
 show_error_dist('0049');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'I';
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no := ''; 
 show_error_dist('0045');
 check_package_failure;
 go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE 
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id := NULL; 
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year := NULL;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'C';
 message('Please re-enter unit ID.',NO_ACKNOWLEDGE); 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 ELSIF NVL(length(temp_v_unit_serial_no), 0) in ('7','9','10','11') 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id IS NOT NULL 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 IF nvl(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_type,'X') = 'I' or NVL(length(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no), 0) > 7 THEN
 show_error_dist('1230');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no;
 go_item('user_response.user_response'); 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 ELSE 
 --Check for Multiple Codabar / Code 128 Records
 /*IF :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NULL or
 (:GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NOT NULL AND
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no != :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no) 
 THEN
 check_multiple_units(temp_v_unit_id,:global.chapter_id );
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;*/ 
 Validate_unit_scan_Code128(temp_v_unit_id,'M','I',temp_v_out_unit_id,temp_v_out_chk_digit); 
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := null;
 IF temp_v_out_chk_digit = '-*' THEN
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := temp_v_out_chk_digit;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := substr(temp_v_unit_id,1,13);
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'I';
 -- go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left);
 ELSE
 show_error_dist('1230');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF; 
END;

procedure update_pick_slip_products is
-- show product status as 'CK' checked in
begin
 update pick_slip_products
 set product_status = :g_product_status_ck,
 program_id = :prog_name
 where unit_id = :product_info.unit_id
 and pick_slip_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_pick_slip_id
 and product_code = :product_info.product_code
 and aliquot = :product_info.aliquot
 and chapter_id = :g_chapter_id
 and coll_date = :product_info.coll_date;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then

 -- slip selected

 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: UPDATE_PICK_SLIPS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure update_pick_slips is
-- if there are not any more products on this pick slip
-- close the pick slip, note their product status is 'OD'
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.X
 from pick_slip_products
 where pick_slip_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_pick_slip_id
 and chapter_id = :g_chapter_id
 and product_status = :g_product_status;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 -- found no products for this pick slip so close the pick slip
 begin
 update pick_slips
 set pick_slip_status = :g_pick_slip_status_cl,
 program_id = :prog_name
 where chapter_id = :g_chapter_id
 and pick_slip_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_pick_slip_id;
 exception
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 null;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

-- this procedure commits all changes and display order number that has
-- been generated

 copy('5','system.message_level');
 commit;
 --post;

end;
